summary: Electric power tool brand Greenworks is expanding its battery-forward lineup in a huge way with the launch of OPTIMUS, an all-new, go-anywhere electric side-by-side utility vehicle that packs over 100 equivalent hp and a 40 mph top speed. more…

title: Elderly Florida man leads police on wild 16 mph e-bike chase. Thank goodness they caught him
summary: Residents of New Smyrna Beach, Florida, can finally breathe a sigh of relief. A dangerous menace to society has been taken off the streets after police apprehended a 75-year-old man accused of leading deputies on a high-stakes electric bike chase at speeds reaching a blistering 16 mph (26 km/h). more…

title: Amflow launches its first city e-bikes, packing huge torque and serious smart tech
summary: Amflow has made a name for itself in the electric mountain bike world with its high-performance Avinox-powered machines , but now the company is bringing that same technology to a decidedly more urban environment. The newly unveiled Amflow UE Carbon series marks the brand’s first move into the commuter e-bike market, combining a lightweight carbon fiber frame, powerful mid-drive motor, and a surprisingly long list of smart features designed for everyday riding. And while these might look like fairly conventional step-through city bikes at first glance, there’s some seriously impressive technology hiding beneath those clean lines. more…

title: BYD spotted testing another boxy midsize SUV
summary: BYD is preparing to launch a new midsize SUV under its personalized, off-road-focused sub-brand. The new SUV was spotted testing, offering an early look at its boxy, rugged-looking design. more…

title: BYD’s luxury SUV pulled a nearly 400,000-pound jumbo jet on just two wheels [Video]
summary: Most SUVs are lucky to tow a small trailer without breaking a sweat. BYD’s new luxury SUV had a slightly bigger challenge: pulling a nearly 400,000-pound jumbo jet. And somehow, it did it on just two wheels. The video is worth a look. more…

title: Ford’s first LFP batteries are en route, and the $30,000 Fathom EV pickup will get them first
summary: Ford has entered the battery business. The first LFP battery cells are now rolling off the assembly line at Ford’s BlueOval Battery Park plant in Michigan and are headed to power Fathom prototypes in Kentucky. more…

title: IONNA enables Plug & Charge for Tesla, opens 22 bay site in Westminster, CA
summary: IONNA, the DC charging operator backed by several major OEMs , has opened its largest DC charging site yet, with 22 bays of 400kW charging in Westminster, California. Alongside the opening, IONNA is also enabling Plug & Charge operation for Tesla EVs, with Stellantis EVs “coming soon.” more…

title: Kia went from this one quirky EV 40 years ago to an entire electric lineup
summary: The Kia Besta EV hit the roads in 1986 as the brand’s first fully electric vehicle. 40 years later, Kia continues to “lead the pack” with a full lineup of EVs ranging from entry-level cars and SUVs to three-row models, and just about everything in between. more…

title: Rivian’s ALSO pauses high-tech e-bike deliveries over ‘software issues’ that we saw coming
summary: Rivian’s new electric bike spinoff, ALSO, has hit another speed bump. The company has announced that it is temporarily halting deliveries of its TM-B electric bicycles after discovering software-related problems affecting some bikes, including issues with charging behavior. more…

title: Tesla toughens FSD driver monitoring in Europe while loosening it in the US
summary: Tesla is rolling out stricter driver monitoring for its “Full Self-Driving” system in Europe, with earlier warnings, a full strike for drivers who look away during a manoeuvre, and a hands-on-wheel requirement above 130 km/h (81 mph). In the US, Tesla has spent the last year going the other way. Its CEO told owners they can text and drive on FSD, and recent US builds were tuned to nag drivers less. more…

title: Tesla’s Semi Megacharger network hits 7 sites, far short of 37 goal
summary: Tesla has opened its first Semi Megacharger in Texas, an 8-stall station in Mesquite on the east side of Dallas. With it, Tesla’s map now lists 7 public Megacharger sites and 44 stalls for its electric truck. That’s progress. But with six weeks left in 2026, it’s less than a fifth of the 37 sites Tesla planned to have open this year. more…

title: Toyota expands C-HR EV recall to 19,000 globally
summary: Toyota is recalling 19,000 electric C-HR SUVs globally, with about 10,000 affected in the US. more…

title: US battery storage just topped 200 GWh – here’s where it is
summary: The US has installed more than 200 gigawatt-hours (GWh) of battery storage, with nearly 50 GWh coming online in the first nine months of 2026 alone. more…

title: Volvo EWR150 Electric wheeled excavator gets to work in Luxembourg
summary: As no-drip, low-noise job sites become more the global rule rather than the exception, Volvo’s incredibly versatile EWR150 Electric wheeled excavators are proving to be a smart addition to construction and municipal fleets – that’s proving true in Luxembourg, as well. more…

title: West Coast Customs turns a Tesla Model 3 into a 1955 Chevy Bel Air
summary: West Coast Customs has finished its first electric Chevy Bel Air, and there’s not much Chevy left under the paint. The Burbank shop cut the body off a Tesla Model 3, kept the entire rolling platform, and set a 1955 Bel Air shell on top of it. The result, called Project B-Zero, looks like a ’55 Chevy from the curb and like a Model 3 as soon as you open the door. And it charges at Tesla Superchargers. more…
